notes:
# OverCue firmware 0.13.0

- New Fader Start option in Shortcuts, off by default. Bringing the deck's channel on air from a linked mixer, with the channel fader or crossfader, starts a paused deck; taking it off air doesn't stop it or cue back. With Quantize on, the start lands on the beat with the master, including when Beat Sync is matching BPM only. With full Beat Sync on, it uses the player's synced start.
- Stems keep playing in Master Tempo reverse, including the first moments after pressing Reverse, instead of switching to the full mix.
- Beat jumps of 8 to 128 beats, forward or back, land on stems that are ready to play, following the beat grid currently on the player.
- Fewer stem dropouts when playing stems from other linked players' media: playback recovers from a lost network reply in a fraction of a second instead of a second or more, and every stem you're playing stays loaded well ahead.
- Right after a track loads, the full mix plays instead of silence while the stems you selected are still loading.
- DJM-A9 Stems EQ control holds through brief mixer communication delays.
- Phrase and vocal indicators now load after the stems you're playing are ready, and nothing is read for them when both are turned off in Shortcuts.
- Lower memory use over long sets with stems.
